longDescription: This package contains all the tools bundled as MATE utilities: - mate-disk-usage-analyzer, a disk usage analyser - mate-dictionary, a program which can look up the definition of words over the internet (including a panel applet to do the same) - mate-search-tool, with which one can find files by name or content - mate-system-log, a log viewing application - mate-screenshot, a tool to take desktop screenshots and save them into a file
